conceptDoiAdjudication.reason: The concept DOI currently resolves to record 18176373, a later FINAL_article version containing the article PDF but not the two raw-data ZIP archives.

rawDataAdjudication.reason: Every TG curve is blank-subtracted and several TG/dTG columns carry an explicit |s smoothing marker. The record's use of the word raw must not be interpreted as untouched detector output.
acceptedFacts: The retained 18 composite curves are byte-identical to their members in the pinned official TG_DTG_DTA_data.zip.
The retained nine kinetic exports are byte-identical to their members in the pinned official Kinetic data.zip.
TG and dTG physical column positions change across files and must be resolved from exact headers.
CEL and CELS single-rate curves remain in the official archive but are intentionally outside this six-rate composite lane.

oracleAdjudication.reason: The independent recipes reproduce the broad trend but not exact Kinetics Neo values, especially at low conversion. Exact author preprocessing is not deposited.
missingAuthorSettings: definition and confidence level of exported ±Error

publicationDiscrepancies.publicationLocation: Article and Zenodo Table 2, step A→B

implementedInArticle: extended Prout–Tompkins / modified Šesták–Berggren multi-step fitting

productionHandoff.rawPath: wide-series ingestion of each retained instrument export with TG mapped to massPercent, explicit initialValue=100 and finalValue=min(observed TG) anchors, and signed deposited dTG mapped to the semantic massChangeRate field
requiredWarnings: WIDE_MASS_REFERENCE_EXCURSION_OUTSIDE_BRANCH when raw pre-branch TG exceeds the explicit 100% anchor
productionHandoff.forbiddenShortcut: Do not map signed dTG to the long-layout dAlphaDt role.
productionHandoff.scopeBoundary: The production comparison validates the public wide-series ingestion and Friedman engine against the independent DEPOSITED_DTG oracle at all 91 alpha targets. TG_LOCAL_LINEAR_7 remains application-independent diagnostic evidence because it intentionally uses a different derivative reconstruction.

rebaselinePolicy: Any source byte, archive member, header semantic, explicit recipe, oracle implementation, expected output, or adjudication change requires a written scientific reason and a fresh audit.
